The best eSIM plans for Thailand

The Roamless Thailand eSIM gets you online the moment you land, from Bangkok's airport to a beach in the south. Most travelers just leave their home carrier's roaming on, but those plans give you little data for the price and it's easy to overspend. Roamless gives you Thai data at honest rates instead. From a week island-hopping to a month-long stay, the same eSIM covers you from day 1 to day 30.

Three ways to pay, depending on how you travel:

  • Pay as You Go. Top up your Balance once and only spend what you use. Your Credits never expire, and auto top-up keeps you online. One Balance covers 200+ destinations, handy if you're pairing Thailand with the rest of Southeast Asia.
  • Data Plan. A fixed amount of data for a set window, paid by card, when you want a known cost upfront.
  • Unlimited Plan. One fixed price for the whole trip with nothing to track. You get 3GB a day at full speed, then the connection eases to 1Mbps until your allowance resets 24 hours later, still fine for maps, messaging, and calls, and any day you want full speed you can switch to your Credits. We show that daily amount and the slower speed up front, which is more than most "unlimited" eSIMs will tell you.

Neither one is ever throttled. Roamless runs at full speed the whole trip.

Coverage runs on tier-one Thai networks, currently AIS, True, and Dtac, so 5G holds across Bangkok, Chiang Mai, and the main islands. Local tip: on the ferries out to Koh Tao or the Phi Phi islands the signal comes and goes, so download maps and ferry times before you leave the pier. Heading to Phuket or on across the region? Stay on Pay as You Go, or the Asia and Oceania Data Plan covers the wider region.

Setup takes minutes on any eSIM compatible iPhone or Android, and hotspot is included so you can tether or share with travel companions. Buy ahead without worry: your Balance or Data Plan only starts when the eSIM connects to a Thai carrier. Before you fly, turn off data roaming on your home carrier's line (your existing SIM, not Roamless) so you're never double-charged.

New to Roamless? Your first 500 MB is on us.
